note: R1022 finding, landed under R1021: the entry's own worked example gives the wrong rounded result.

entries.reason: The description's example is arithmetically wrong: rounding 62 and 27 to the nearest ten gives 60 - 30 = 30, not 40. Its own carrier MC01-CALC-02 (Work out 62 - 27; distractor 30) and that option's execution already say 30. A drafter reading the description would build distractors from a false example.
